mostWorthwhile.text: The ending's handoff of the preserved specimens provides a satisfying payoff to the discovery, while leaving their nature open for investigation.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final chapter has no playable decisions; it is a short closing passage rather than a combination puzzle.

surprise.text: The ending leaves the discovery unresolved rather than claiming that the specimens have already been understood.

arbitrary.text: No action in the final chapter felt arbitrary because there were no actions to choose.

continue.text: I would be curious to see what the receiving scientists learn, though this ending feels complete and offers no gameplay on which to judge a further chapter.
